name: What is the process for professional vomit cleanup?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for professional vomit cleanup?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our professional vomit cleanup process begins with a rapid assessment of the affected area and the extent of contamination. We then implement safety protocols, including wearing personal protective equipment, before carefully removing all visible vomit and contaminated items. This is followed by thorough cleaning and disinfection using hospital-grade biocides to eliminate pathogens. Finally, we apply specialized deodorizers to neutralize odors and ensure the area is left clean and fresh, often with follow-up air purification if needed.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes assessment, safe removal of vomit, thorough cleaning and disinfection with hospital-grade biocides, and specialized deodorization.
